shared_state: src/context.ts per-request mutable Context passed through middleware

naming.files: kebab-case TypeScript files and directories; middleware/router variants use index.ts or router.ts with colocated *.test.ts
naming.functions: camelCase exported factories and functions; inner middleware functions are named after their factory

logging.pattern: No global logger; logger middleware accepts injected PrintFunc defaulting to console.log, uses -->/<--/xxx prefixes and status colors with NO_COLOR opt-out

pitfalls.what: On the first match, SmartRouter adds buffered routes to candidate routers and permanently binds the first router that does not signal UnsupportedPathError.
pitfalls.consequence: Cold-start latency scales with route count and candidate routers; router ordering and the first request can determine the backend used for the lifetime of the instance.

pitfalls.what: The first match replaces the matcher and immediately performs matcher construction before returning the result.
pitfalls.consequence: The first request pays hidden regex compilation and route-build work, which can dominate cold-start latency.

pitfalls.what: Post-freeze add/match failure paths use distinct public and opaque fatal errors.
pitfalls.consequence: Adding routes after matcher construction is unsupported, and opaque fatal errors make diagnosis of unexpected router state difficult.

run.command: No application server run command; this repository publishes a library consumed by importing the package.

damage_control_rules: Do not update application source, dependencies, permissions, policies, runtime code, or workflows through automatic learning.
Keep CI permissions read-only except explicitly scoped release publishing identity.
Do not read dotenv files, PEM keys, or secrets.* paths.

D1_topography.evidence_summary: Root inventory, README, and package metadata identify Hono as a TypeScript Web Standards framework with source under src, build tooling under build, runtime tests, and Bun/npm scripts.

evidence.excerpt: Hono is a small, simple, and ultrafast web framework built on Web Standards.
"build": "bun run --shell bun remove-dist && bun ./build/build.ts && bun run copy:package.cjs.json",

D2_module_boundaries.evidence_summary: Core HonoBase dispatches through the Router contract into interchangeable SmartRouter/RegExpRouter/TrieRouter implementations, while Context and Request carry per-request state through compose and handlers.

evidence.excerpt: this.router = options.router ?? new SmartRouter({ routers: [new RegExpRouter(), new TrieRouter()] })

D3_type_contract.evidence_summary: HandlerInterface is a real TypeScript interface defining route-registration overloads; HonoBase declares the typed methods, Hono inherits them, and type-level tests verify inference and schema accumulation.

D4_conventions.evidence_summary: Source follows kebab-case files/directories, PascalCase classes, camelCase functions, and SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants; middleware and routers use colocated tests, and errors distinguish HTTPException from programmer errors.

evidence.excerpt: export const logger = (fn: PrintFunc = console.log): MiddlewareHandler

D5_pitfalls.evidence_summary: Router selection and matcher construction have observable cold-start and freeze semantics: SmartRouter builds candidate routers during first match and permanently binds the first accepted implementation, so route order and first-request shape affect latency and behavior.

D6_validation.evidence_summary: Repository scripts and CI define frozen Bun install, formatting, lint, editorconfig, build, TypeScript-aware tests, runtime matrices, coverage, and package/JSR validation; CI requires the core checks on changes.

evidence.excerpt: Please ensure your PR passes tests with `bun run test`.

D7_operational.evidence_summary: Hono is a library with no application server command; package metadata defines Bun install/build/watch and CI defines main/next integration plus tag release behavior.

evidence.excerpt: "build": "bun run --shell bun remove-dist && bun ./build/build.ts && bun run copy:package.cjs.json"
"watch": "bun run --shell bun remove-dist && bun ./build/build.ts --watch && bun run copy:package.cjs.json"

D8_security.evidence_summary: Tracked repository controls exclude dotenv/key material and CI is read-only; source security utilities provide constant-time comparison and traversal defenses.

D9_process.evidence_summary: Tracked issue templates, pull-request checklist, contribution guide, and CI document the repository lifecycle without relying on an agentic layer.

evidence.excerpt: Please ensure your PR passes tests with `bun run test`.

D10_documentation.evidence_summary: README is the authoritative project overview with purpose, quick start, features, supported runtimes, contribution links, and release/community pointers; docs/CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/MIGRATION.md provide maintainer and compatibility guidance.
